disseminations.headline: UNAUTHORIZED PACKED MESS
disseminations.content:
All Cadets are reminded that packed mess is only authorized for workouts requiring a working mess set up and for cadets who are physically and medically unable to go to the Yap Hall for messing. Non compliance means delinquency report. 
Issuance of packed mess to any person without the authorization of the Regimental mess officer shall be reported for usurpation of authority and will be dealt with accordingly.
disseminations.author: REGIMENTAL MESS OFFICER
